title: Provisions and Contingencies
intro: **المخصص** يُسجل لو: التزام حالي من حدث سابق + خروج موارد **مرجّح** + تقدير موثوق.
**الالتزام المحتمل** لا يُسجل، يُفصح عنه إلا لو احتماله بعيد (remote).
**الأصل المحتمل** لا يُسجل إلا لو شبه مؤكد، ويُفصح عنه لو مرجّح.

tf.s: A provision is a liability of uncertain timing or amount.
Provisions are discounted when the time value of money is material.
A board decision alone, not communicated before year-end, creates a constructive obligation to restructure.
tf.why: A detailed plan and a valid expectation in those affected are needed.

tf.s: Contingent liabilities are recognised in the statement of financial position.
Provisions for future operating losses are not recognised.
An expected reimbursement is recognised as a separate asset only when virtually certain.

fill.s: A provision needs a present obligation as a result of a ___ event.
A contingent asset is recognised only when the inflow is ___ certain.
No provision is made for future operating ___.
Contingent liabilities are disclosed unless the outflow is ___.

source: Written for IFRS Play from the standard's core requirements. Exact source reference could not be verified from the uploaded document.

je.s: Lawyers say it is probable the company will pay 120,000 in a court case.
Unwinding of the discount on a decommissioning provision: 8,000.

calc.s: Warranty: 1,000 units sold. 90% no defects, 8% minor (100 each), 2% major (500 each). Provision?
Onerous contract: cost to fulfil 50,000, penalty to exit 35,000. Provision?
calc.why: Lower of the cost of fulfilling and the penalty for exiting.

steps: Is there a present obligation from a past event?
Is an outflow of resources probable?
Can the amount be estimated reliably?

items: Restructuring announced with a detailed plan before year-end

multi.s: Which costs can be included in a restructuring provision? (select all)
opts: Lease termination penalties for closed sites
multi.why: Only direct costs not linked to ongoing activities.
